initialization: official PDA v1.1; zero expert up; same seed/order; no old CaM weights
depth_objective: frame macro AbsRel on fixed GT domain; no scale fit
router_objective: 0.01 independent BCE averaged across present gates/blocks; TRAIN-only proxies; no additional boundary depth loss

proxies.reflection: finite positive sensor, abs error > max(.01m,.02GT); holes unknown
proxies.nonflat: depth second differences >= max(.004m,.003GT), 3x3 valid, first jump <= max(.08m,.05GT)
proxies.edge: all 3x3 GT valid; max absolute depth jump to 8 neighbours > max(.01m,.02GT); GT borders/holes unknown; no RGB-only targets
proxies.patch: known coverage >= .25; positive fraction among known >=.02 reflective / .12 nonflat / .02 edge; independent BCE, pos_weight clamp(Nneg/Npos,1,4); overlap allowed

routing: 20-step soft warmup; hard_st thereafter; eval truly sparse independent sigmoid >=.5 at T=.7; no top1
primary_selection: lowest full macro AbsRel among epochs1..12, fixed validation, hard sparse inference
precision: BF16 fine, FP32 conditions/loss, gradient checkpointing
